iso4014.source: ISO 4014 hexagon head bolt (partial thread), M12 coarse (1.75 mm pitch). s=18.0 (across flats, ISO 4014 nominal for M12; ISO reduced this from DIN 931's 19 mm to 18 mm — Fasteners.eu EU 24014 table shows separate DIN 931 and ISO 4014 lines confirming this; confirmed also by ITAFasteners BS EN ISO 4014 table + Jignesh Steel DIN 931/ISO 4014 table + iso-fasteners.com ISO 4014 table). k=7.5 (head height nominal; same sources; Jignesh Steel gives tolerance band 7.32–7.68 mm around 7.5 nominal, grade A). d_shank=12.0 = M12 nominal major diameter; shank drawn as smooth cylinder (envelope only, no thread lines, no bore). length=60.0 is a representative catalog length — M12 ISO 4014 is stocked approximately 20–200 mm per Würth + ITAFasteners + Norelem catalogs; 60 mm is a common mid-range size, not a normative value. head_chamfer=18.0 = s: ISO hex heads chamfer to approximately the across-flats circle at the top face — this dimension is not tabulated separately in ISO 4014 public summaries; setting head_chamfer to s is a representative value (actual chamfer circle is between s and e_min=21.1 mm). tip_chamfer=1.0 mm: 45 degree lead chamfer at the free end of the shank; typical 1–1.5 mm at M12; not individually tabulated in ISO 4014 public tables; representative.

iso4017.source: ISO 4017 fully threaded hex bolt, M12. Shares the same hex head as ISO 4014 for M12 (s=18.0, k=7.5): confirmed by ITAFasteners (separate ISO 4014 and ISO 4017 dimension tables, M12 head row identical in both) + Andrews Fasteners ISO 4017 table (s_nom=18, k_nom=7.5, grade A tol 7.32–7.68) + boltsparts.github.io ISO 4017 table (s=18.0, k=7.5). Only thread coverage differs (ISO 4017 is fully threaded; ISO 4014 is partial thread). Outer envelope at the chosen representative length is identical to iso4014 -> alias.

din931.source: DIN 931 hexagon head bolt (partial thread), M12: s=19.0 (across-flats, the DIN head width — ISO 4014 reduced it to 18.0) and k=7.5, cross-checked ITA Fasteners DIN 931 table + Aspen Fasteners M12 DIN 931/ISO 4014 listing (both s=19, k=7.5). d_shank=12.0 (M12 nominal major); shank drawn as a smooth envelope cylinder (no thread). length=60.0 representative catalog length; head_chamfer=19.0=s (representative, as iso4014); tip_chamfer=1.0 representative.

din933.source: DIN 933 fully threaded hex bolt, M12 — same M12 hex envelope as DIN 931 (s=19, k=7.5); only thread coverage differs (full vs partial, not drawn), so it aliases the DIN base. Confirmed vs ITA Fasteners + Aspen Fasteners DIN 931 tables.

din960.source: DIN 960 fine-pitch (M12x1.5) partial-thread hex bolt — same 19 mm hex head as DIN 931 (confirmed Wuerth DIN 960 M12x1.5 WS19 + Bolt King DIN 960 table, s=19, k=7.5); pitch is not drawn, so it aliases din931.

din961.source: DIN 961 fine-pitch full-thread hex bolt, M12 — same 19 mm hex head as DIN 931 (confirmed StandardBolts DIN 961 + Khainguyen DIN 961 table, s=19); pitch and thread length are not drawn, so it aliases din931.

din931i.source: DIN 931 M12, app image-variant key — identical DIN 931 hex envelope (s=19), aliases the din931 base.

din933i.source: DIN 933 M12, app image-variant key — same M12 DIN hex envelope (s=19) as din931 (full thread not drawn), aliases the din931 base.

din960i.source: DIN 960 M12 fine, app image-variant key — same 19 mm DIN hex head, aliases the din931 base.

din961i.source: DIN 961 M12 fine full, app image-variant key — same 19 mm DIN hex head, aliases the din931 base.

iso8676.source: ISO 8676 fine-pitch full-thread hex bolt, M12 — same M12 ISO hex head as ISO 4014 (s=18, k=7.5); pitch and thread length are not drawn, so it aliases iso4014.

iso8765.source: ISO 8765 fine-pitch partial-thread hex bolt, M12 — same M12 ISO hex head as ISO 4014 (s=18); pitch is not drawn, so it aliases iso4014.

iso4014p.source: ISO 4014 M12, app image-variant key — identical ISO 4014 hex envelope (s=18), aliases the iso4014 base.

iso4017p.source: ISO 4017 M12, app image-variant key — same ISO hex head as ISO 4014 (s=18, full thread not drawn), aliases the iso4014 base.
